# --debug-dir-keep prunes old run-* directories: two runs with keep 1 leave
# exactly one run directory, while two runs without the flag leave two (#397).
exec vens generate --llm=mock --debug-dir dbg --config-file=config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 report.json out1.cdx.json
exists out1.cdx.json
exec vens generate --llm=mock --debug-dir dbg --debug-dir-keep 1 --config-file=config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 report.json out2.cdx.json
exists out2.cdx.json
exec sh -c 'test $(ls -d dbg/run-* | wc -l) -eq 1'

# Without the flag, nothing is pruned.
exec vens generate --llm=mock --debug-dir dbg2 --config-file=config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 report.json out3.cdx.json
exec vens generate --llm=mock --debug-dir dbg2 --config-file=config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 report.json out4.cdx.json
exec sh -c 'test $(ls -d dbg2/run-* | wc -l) -eq 2'

project:

  description: "Test project for integration tests"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
